Wildfire preparedness
At Rocky Mountain Power, we're continuing to take steps to prevent wildfires.
You can also take action at home: Make a plan, create defensible space around your home, and prepare for your family's
needs in the event of an emergency. Consider backup power options for your business or your home, especially if you have
medical equipment. Check your local emergency management or public safety website for more information on how to sign
up for alerts. Update your contact information with us and sign up to receive our alerts.
Learn more about what we're doing and how to prepare at RockyMountainPower.net/Wildfire.
Seguridad y preparación
En Rocky Mountain Power seguimos tomando medidas para prevenir los incendios forestales.
También puedes tomar medidas en casa: Haga un plan, cree un espacio defendible alrededor de su casa y prepárese para las
necesidades de su familia en caso de emergencia. Considere opciones de energía de respaldo en su negocio o en su casa,
sobre todo si tiene equipos medicos. Vea el sitio web de gestión de emergencias o seguridad pública de tu localidad para
obtener más información sobre cómo inscribirse para recibir alertas. Actualice su información de contacto con nosotros y
regístrese para recibir nuestras alertas.
Effective July 1, 2026, the Utah Public Service Commission approved price decreases associated with Rocky Mountain
Power's Energy Balancing Account (EBA). The EBA reflects differences between Rocky Mountain Power's actual costs to
provide electricity and the amount collected through current prices. Your bill may reflect charges at old and new rates.
When you provide a check as payment, you authorize us to use the information from your check either to make a one-time
electronic fund transfer from your account or to process the payment as a check transaction. When we use information from
your check to make an electronic fund transfer, funds may be withdrawn from your account as soon as we receive your pay-
ment and you will not receive your check back from your financial institution. If you would like to opt out of this program and
continue processing your payment as a check transaction, please call 1-800-895-0561. If you have opted out previously,
please disregard this message.
Bill envelope
To make it easy for you, we've switched to a standard return envelope for your bill. Simply apply postage and mail your pay-
ment to us in the envelope provided.

Wildfire preparedness
At Rocky Mountain Power, we're continuing to take steps to prevent wildfires.
You can also take action at home: Make a plan, create defensible space around your home, and prepare for your family's
needs in the event of an emergency. Consider backup power options for your business or your home, especially if you have
medical equipment. Check your local emergency management or public safety website for more information on how to sign
up for alerts. Update your contact information with us and sign up to receive our alerts.
Learn more about what we're doing and how to prepare at RockyMountainPower.net/Wildfire.
Seguridad y preparación
En Rocky Mountain Power seguimos tomando medidas para prevenir los incendios forestales.
También puedes tomar medidas en casa: Haga un plan, cree un espacio defendible alrededor de su casa y prepárese para las
necesidades de su familia en caso de emergencia. Considere opciones de energía de respaldo en su negocio o en su casa,
sobre todo si tiene equipos medicos. Vea el sitio web de gestión de emergencias o seguridad pública de tu localidad para
obtener más información sobre cómo inscribirse para recibir alertas. Actualice su información de contacto con nosotros y
regístrese para recibir nuestras alertas.
The Utah Public Service Commission has approved a settlement agreement in Rocky Mountain Power's 2024 general rate
case (Commission Docket No. 24-035-04). As a result, changes to Utah customers' overall rates are effective as of August 10,
2026. The settlement results in an incremental rate increase of 3.8% over prior base rates. Your bill may reflect charges billed
at old and new rates.
When you provide a check as payment, you authorize us to use the information from your check either to make a one-time
electronic fund transfer from your account or to process the payment as a check transaction. When we use information from
your check to make an electronic fund transfer, funds may be withdrawn from your account as soon as we receive your pay-
ment and you will not receive your check back from your financial institution. If you would like to opt out of this program and
continue processing your payment as a check transaction, please call 1-800-895-0561. If you have opted out previously,
please disregard this message.

Wildfire prevention
At Rocky Mountain Power, we're continuing to take steps to prevent wildfires.
PAGE 3 OF 4
BILLING DATE: Nov 25, 2025 ACCOUNT NUMBER: 90000001-001 1 DUE DATE: Dec 19, 2025 AMOUNT DUE: $24,337.07
Questions about your bill: Call toll free 1-866-870-3419 RockyMountainPower.net
You can also take action at home: Make a plan, create defensible space around your home, and prepare for your family's
needs in the event of an emergency. Consider a backup generator for your business or your home, especially if you have
medical equipment. Check your local emergency management or public safety website for more information on how to sign
up for alerts. Update your contact information with us and sign up to receive our alerts.
Learn more about what we're doing and how to prepare at RockyMountainPower.net/Wildfire.
Seguridad y preparación
En Rocky Mountain Power seguimos tomando medidas para prevenir los incendios forestales.
También puedes tomar medidas en casa: Haga un plan, cree un espacio defendible alrededor de su casa y prepárese para las
necesidades de su familia en caso de emergencia. Considere la posibilidad de instalar un generador de reserva en su negocio
o en su casa, sobre todo si tiene equipos médicos. Vea el sitio web de gestión de emergencias o seguridad pública de tu
localidad para obtener más información sobre cómo inscribirte para recibir alertas. Actualice su información de contacto con
nosotros y regístrese para recibir nuestras alertas.
Para más información sobre lo que estamos haciendo y cómo prepararse en RockyMountainPower.net/Wildfire.
When you provide a check as payment, you authorize us to use the information from your check either to make a one-time
electronic fund transfer from your account or to process the payment as a check transaction. When we use information from
your check to make an electronic fund transfer, funds may be withdrawn from your account as soon as we receive your pay-
ment and you will not receive your check back from your financial institution. If you would like to opt out of this program and
continue processing your payment as a check transaction, please call 1-800-895-0561. If you have opted out previously,
please disregard this message.
Manage your account with ease
Popular billing options include Auto Pay, Equal Pay and choice of due dates. You can even earn a credit each month when you
sign up for paperless billing. See details and enroll at RockyMountainPower.net/BillOptions

You can also take action at home: Make a plan, create defensible space around your home, and prepare for your family's
needs in the event of an emergency. Consider a backup generator for your business or your home, especially if you have
medical equipment. Check your local emergency management or public safety website for more information on how to sign
up for alerts. Update your contact information with us and sign up to receive our alerts.
Learn more about what we're doing and how to prepare at RockyMountainPower.net/Wildfire.
Seguridad y preparación
En Rocky Mountain Power seguimos tomando medidas para prevenir los incendios forestales.
También puedes tomar medidas en casa: Haga un plan, cree un espacio defendible alrededor de su casa y prepárese para las
necesidades de su familia en caso de emergencia. Considere la posibilidad de instalar un generador de reserva en su negocio
o en su casa, sobre todo si tiene equipos médicos. Vea el sitio web de gestión de emergencias o seguridad pública de tu
localidad para obtener más información sobre cómo inscribirte para recibir alertas. Actualice su información de contacto con
nosotros y regístrese para recibir nuestras alertas.
Para más información sobre lo que estamos haciendo y cómo prepararse en RockyMountainPower.net/Wildfire.
Your bill reflects a change for "Excess Liability Insurance Premiums Correction," which was approved by the Utah Public Ser-
vice Commission effective on April 25, 2025. Your bill may include both the old and new prices.
When you provide a check as payment, you authorize us to use the information from your check either to make a one-time
electronic fund transfer from your account or to process the payment as a check transaction. When we use information from
your check to make an electronic fund transfer, funds may be withdrawn from your account as soon as we receive your pay-
ment and you will not receive your check back from your financial institution. If you would like to opt out of this program and
continue processing your payment as a check transaction, please call 1-800-895-0561. If you have opted out previously,
please disregard this message.
